propositions: Add a shrink-only complexity baseline wrapper that accepts Ruff's C901 output and enforces ceilings per qualified function symbol (path::class.function), refusing new/increased debt while permitting decreases

Baseline JSON must validate schema (schema_version 1, sorted keys, integer ceilings > 15), reject duplicates/unknown fields, and derive stable AST-qualified symbol identity from nested functions/async methods/overloads without line-number churn

Repository gate invokes the wrapper via `make lint` to reject new/increased complexity debt against .github/complexity-baseline.json while maintaining existing Ruff and format checks for both src and tests

Maintenance mode `--update-stale` uses atomic_write to lower/remove stale ceilings only, refusing to write if new/increased debt or scanner errors exist, with tests verifying no temporary file leakage on write/replace failures
